column5: Anti-lysozyme VHH, PDB 1MEL chain A, the structure that first showed a VHH paratope. Canonical disulfide PLUS a second CDR1-CDR3 pair, and a 26-residue CDR3. The entry continues GRYPYDVPDYGSGRA (HA tag) after VTVSS; not included. DNA back-translated by this app, not the published gene.

Anti-von Willebrand factor VHH, PDB 7EOW chain B. The first nanobody-based medicine approved (Cablivi). The entry has a leading M and a trailing LEHHHHHH; not included. DNA back-translated by this app, not the published gene.
Lama glama VHH that stabilises the active state of the beta2 adrenergic receptor, PDB 3P0G chain B - the conformational-chaperone use of nanobodies. Trailing HHHHHH not included.

Anti-GFP nanobody 'Enhancer', PDB 3K1K chain C. Scores 3/4 hallmarks, not 4/4, and has a short 8-residue CDR3. Leading M and trailing HHHHHH not included. DNA back-translated by this app, not the published gene.

Anti-GFP nanobody 'Minimizer', PDB 3G9A chain B - the companion to the Enhancer, with the opposite effect on GFP fluorescence. Extra FR2-CDR3 disulfide and a 25-residue CDR3. Leading MA and trailing HHHHHH not included.
Nanobody against the ALFA tag, PDB 6I2G chain A - the detection-tag system. Scores only 2/4 hallmarks despite being a genuine, widely used VHH. Leading SG not included.

Alpaca nanobody neutralising SARS-CoV-2, PDB 6ZXN chains D-F. Scores 1/4 hallmarks with a VH-like WVRQ FR2, so the app calls it ambiguous - a real published VHH that proves the hallmark score is indicative, not a classification. Leading M and trailing GGLPETGGHHHHHH not included.
Anti-EGFR VHH 7D12, PDB 4KRL. Lama glama. Trailing ALEHHHHHH not included.
Anti-HER2 VHH 2Rs15d, PDB 5MY6 chain B, used as an imaging tracer. Carries an extra CDR1-CDR3 disulfide and a very short CDR3.
Nb.b201, PDB 5VNV - from a synthetic yeast-display library rather than an immunised animal, so a useful contrast with the others. Trailing LE not included.
Heavy variable domain of trastuzumab, PDB 1N8Z chain B, trimmed at the end of VTVSS. A conventional VH: 0/4 hallmarks, ~100% identity to a human germline.
Light (kappa) variable domain of trastuzumab, PDB 1N8Z chain A, trimmed at the end of KVEIK. Classified as a light-chain V domain, so the antibody tabs skip it.
The whole heavy chain of PDB 1N8Z chain B: VH followed by CH1, 220 residues. The V domain covers 55%, so the app reports 'contains a V domain' and skips the VHH analyses.

Hen egg-white lysozyme, PDB 1MEL chain C - the antigen cAbLys3 binds. Not an antibody domain, so only the generic analyses run. Its eight cysteines form four ordinary disulfides and are correctly not flagged as free thiols.
